description: Source code for the SqlComplianceStore class handling compliance data storage and export in Mattermost, including methods for saving, updating, retrieving, and exporting compliance records and messages.

classes.name: SqlComplianceStore
classes.description: A class for managing compliance data in SQL database, including methods for CRUD operations and exporting compliance posts and messages.

methods.name: newSqlComplianceStore
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new SqlComplianceStore instance.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a compliance record to the database.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing compliance record in the database.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all compliance records with pagination.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific compliance record by ID.

methods.name: ComplianceExport
methods.description: Exports compliance posts based on a job and cursor, supporting keyword and email filtering.

methods.name: MessageExport
methods.description: Exports messages with filtering based on update time and message type.
